news.notes: The Ducks placed Sennecke on injured reserve Saturday; the forward played 17:51 during a 4-0 loss at the Colorado Avalanche on Thursday after missing an 8-6 loss at the St. Louis Blues on Tuesday. ... Anaheim recalled Myatovic from San Diego of the American Hockey League on Saturday. ... The Mammoth held an optional morning skate. ... There will be some game-time lineup decisions among the forward group, Utah coach Andre Tourigny said. ... Biber, a defenseman, was recalled from Tucson of the AHL on Saturday.

injuries.name: Elias Pettersson
injuries.comment: Pettersson (upper body) isn't expected to play against Chicago on Sunday, per Canucks play-by-play announcer Brendan Batchelor.

injuries.name: Brendan Gallagher
injuries.comment: Gallagher (lower body) was placed on injured reserve Saturday.

injuries.name: Thatcher Demko
injuries.comment: Co-president of hockey operations Henrik Sedin said Monday that he hopes Demko (hip) will be ready to return before Christmas, Kevin Woodley of NHL.com reports.

news.notes: Hughes is returning to Minnesota to be evaluated; the defenseman left a 4-1 win at the Calgary Flames on Thursday following a hit from Flames forward Adam Klapka at 9:57 of the third period that forced him out of the game. … Spacek will come in after being scratched the past five games and will play on the third defense pair with Bogosian. ... Trenin will return after missing one game due to personal reasons and forward Tyler Pitlick was sent back to Iowa of the American Hockey League after being called up Thursday. … Gustavsson has been medically cleared to play for the first time since having offseason hip surgery and is expected to play for Iowa on Saturday. … Pettersson, a center, is day to day and is expected to miss the next two games. ... Gallagher was placed on injured reserve; the forward was injured during a 5-1 loss at the Seattle Kraken on Thursday but general manager Ryan Johnson said it does not appear to be as serious as first feared. … Mueller and Quillan each was recalled from Abbotsford in the American Hockey League on Saturday after Pettersson’s injury and the Canucks trading center Max Sasson to the New York Rangers on Friday. … Tolopilo was also called up from Abbotsford on Saturday; the goalie could start against the Chicago Blackhawks on Sunday.

injuries.comment: Keyser (upper body) was placed on non-roster injured reserve by the Sharks on Monday, Curtis Pashelka of The San Jose Mercury News reports.

news.notes: Each team held an optional morning skate. ... The Kraken practiced Friday with the same lines they used in a 5-1 win against the Vancouver Canucks on Thursday. ... Grubauer did not skate Friday for maintenance but will be available. ... Graf, a forward, and Kesselring, a defenseman, each will be a healthy scratch, according to Sharks coach Ryan Warsofsky. ... Allan will enter the lineup after being a healthy scratch the past eight games. ... Leason will make his San Jose debut and play in his first NHL game since Jan. 17, 2026, with the Washington Capitals.

injuries.name: Jake O'Brien
injuries.comment: The Kraken indicated Thursday that O'Brien (lower body) remains week-to-week, Mike Benton of the Kraken Audio Network reports.

injuries.name: Jared McCann
injuries.comment: McCann (lower body) will be out for approximately 10 weeks, the team announced Sunday.
